info.name: Brushfire API: Version 2025-07-22 AccessCodes Data API
Returns specialized data from custom-written queries

params.name: id
params.description: The GUID for the query you are running

params.name: eventNumber
params.description: If present, an integer representing the event number

params.name: granularity
params.description: If present, one of the following string values "hour", "minute", or "day"

params.name: startsAt
params.description: If present, the date/time in UTC to start data

params.name: endsAt
params.description: If present, the date/time in UTC to end data
